name: Jenna Begay
source:
Jenna was born and raised in Echo. Her parents named her Jasmynn, after the street they lived on. She spent her life in an abusive family, which she ran away from when she became of age, with help of Chase. She is proud of her Meseta heritage and is willing to confront people who disrespect her culture, despite the bad blood between herself and her family.

Jenna is pragmatic and resourceful; she is likely the most well educated member of the group. While warm and reassuring, she can sometimes come across as cold and dispassionate.
